Required chapter check

Selection 1

In an early-pregnancy model, hCG cannot act on the corpus luteum. Which consequence is most directly predicted?

Selection 2

Which conclusion is not established by detecting hCG alone?

Answer the selections correctly to unlock the writing.

Written explanations

Written explanation 1

Maximum 3200 characters. Explain the biology in your own words.

Compare after saving your own response

Trophoblast-derived tissue releases hCG. hCG maintains the ovarian corpus luteum, which continues secreting progesterone and estrogen. These hormones support the endometrium and help prevent the normal menstrual shedding associated with falling ovarian hormones.

Written explanation 2

Maximum 3200 characters. Explain the biology in your own words.

Compare after saving your own response

The placenta increasingly produces progesterone and estrogen during the first trimester. The hormonal source changes over development, so progesterone can remain supported even when hCG falls from an earlier peak.

Required chapter check

Selection 1

Which pair shares an ectodermal origin?

Selection 2

Why is “the entire digestive system comes from endoderm” too broad?

Answer the selections correctly to unlock the writing.

Written explanations

Written explanation 1

Maximum 3200 characters. Explain the biology in your own words.

Compare after saving your own response

Gastrulation reorganizes embryonic cells through movement and produces ectoderm, mesoderm and endoderm. Each layer contributes to particular tissue lineages as development continues. This is a change in organization and developmental pathways, not just an increase in cell number.

Check your explanation for:
  • Identifies the relevant structures or quantities.
  • Explains the causal relationship or calculation, not just the final result.
  • Uses the stated evidence and avoids a stronger conclusion than it supports.

Written explanation 2

Maximum 3200 characters. Explain the biology in your own words.

Compare after saving your own response

Intestinal smooth muscle is a mesodermal derivative, whereas much of the intestinal epithelial lining is endodermal. One organ contains several tissue types, so a change can affect one developmental contribution without identically affecting the other.
